manage.restored: Restored as delisted. Review the entry before listing it again.
manage.uploadHint: One skill per ZIP, including SKILL.md. Select multiple ZIPs. New entries are delisted for review; duplicate names are not overwritten. No scripts are executed.
manage.deleteHint: Entries go to trash and cannot be discovered or installed from the store. Installed copies and authors' personal skills are preserved. Uninstall separately in desktop management.
manage.name: Stable name (lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens)
manage.title: Display name
manage.icon: Display icon (emoji or HTTPS image URL)
manage.createHint: New entries start delisted. The stable name must match the SKILL.md name.
manage.editHint: Edits affect the store and future installs, not the author's private draft or existing user copies. Stable names cannot change.
manage.invalidJson: Enter a valid MCP JSON object.

desktop.collection: Collection ({{count}} skills): {{names}}. Uninstall removes the entire collection directory.
desktop.hint: Select a desktop and workspace member, then scan Skill / MCP installations, including manual installs. Scans never start or create desktops or read another user's directory.
desktop.search: Search desktop ID, workspace, username or email
desktop.empty: No assigned desktops found. Platform install history is available in the other tab.
desktop.noMember: No active workspace member is available to scan.
desktop.unknown: Actual install state is unknown. Check desktop and connection status, then retry.
desktop.partial: Scan incomplete ({{kinds}}). Unavailable kinds have unknown state, not zero installs.
desktop.scannedAt: Scanned at {{time}}. This is a point-in-time snapshot; refresh when needed.
desktop.noSkills: Scan complete: no Skill or MCP is installed for this user.
desktop.removed: Uninstalled and verified by read-back. Author archives and other users' copies are preserved.
desktop.removeFailed: Uninstall could not be verified. Scan again before retrying.
desktop.removeHint: Remove only {{dir}} for user {{user}} on desktop {{desktop}}. Store entries and author archives are preserved. Automatic restoration of this personal archive is paused to prevent it reappearing. Other users are unaffected.

title: Skill management
subtitle: List and delist store entries, review submissions, and see who installed what.

list.error: This list could not be loaded. Try again shortly.

store.search: Search by title, author, or catalog_id
store.empty: The store has no entries yet.

dialog.reasonPlaceholder: Give a specific reason. It will be recorded in the audit log.
dialog.failed: That did not go through. Try again shortly.

list.title: List {{title}}
list.body: Once listed, every user can find and install this entry from the store.

delist.title: Delist {{title}}
delist.body: The store stops showing it and no one can install it again; copies already in a sandbox keep working. The author is told why.

approve.title: Approve {{title}}
approve.body: Approving moves this submission into the store's community section, visible to everyone.

reject.title: Reject {{title}}
reject.body: The reason reaches the author along with the skill name and version, and they can resubmit after fixing it.

review.pick: Pick a submission on the left to read it.
review.skillMdNotice: Shown as plain text — no Markdown rendering, nothing executed.
review.archiveRefused: The server did not open this archive (too large, absurdly many members, or not a readable ZIP). No manifest and no file list below does not mean the package is empty — nobody read these bytes.
review.truncated: Too long to show in full; the rest is cut off.
review.filesTruncated: Too many entries to list; only the first ones are shown.
review.downloadFailed: The download failed. Try again shortly.
review.loadFailed: This submission could not be loaded.

installs.search: Search by username, email, or skill name
installs.footnote: This is platform install history, not current state. Use Actual desktop installs to view manual installs, check existence, or uninstall.
